title: Nightmare Abbey
author: Thomas Love Peacock
description: "Nightmare Abbey" by Thomas Love Peacock is a novella written in 1818 that satirizes the gloomy excesses of Romantic literature.
longDescription: Set in an isolated mansion, the story follows melancholy Christopher Glowry and his son Scythrop, who becomes entangled with two women while hiding a mysterious fugitive.

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Love Peacock (1785–1866) wrote Nightmare Abbey. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
